results.content: # 75% of US Adults Aren't Interested in a Foldable iPhone. Three out of four U.S. adults say they have no interest in buying a foldable iPhone, according to a new survey from *CNET*. *CNET*'s survey was conducted online by YouGov between August 13 and 17, polling 2,605 U.S. adults. It found that 75% are not interested in an Apple foldable device, and those who are would not pay anywhere near the rumored $2,000+ price.
